mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to higher nominal interest rates and increased equity valuations as investors demand higher returns to compensate for inflation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers a flight to quality and reduced corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic contraction, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of RSAFS and INDPRO fails to predict negative 60d returns in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), a rising Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals that inflation is outpacing the Fed's policy response, leading to increased uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, the combination of rising CPIAUCSL and negative returns fails to hold (i.e., 20d returns are positive in >40% of such events).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between rising HOUST and 20d forward returns fails to hold (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months fails to predict negative 5d returns in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS >= 5.0%) signals a lack of monetary policy support for a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS >= 5.0%) fails to predict negative 20d returns in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth rate > 3.0% annualized), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening consumer sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized), the decline in RSAFS > 0.5% fails to predict negative 60d returns in more than 35% of cases.
